description.zh: 参数化人体模型的标定：用同一测量程序量出各样本，与“同身高、同 BMI 的真人”（ANSUR II / NHANES 回归）比较。z 以人群残差标准差为单位，|z|<1 表示在真人常见范围内。网格 BMI 由体积按 1010 kg/m3 换算。
description.en: Calibration of the parametric body models: every sample is measured with the same measurer and compared with real people of the same stature and BMI (ANSUR II / NHANES regressions). z is in population residual SDs; |z| < 1 is within the usual human range. Mesh BMI is from volume at 1010 kg/m3.

note.zh: 各测量值对前 8 个身份系数的线性回归（毫米；BMI 为 kg/m2）
note.en: measurement = intercept + sum_i perComponent[i] * identity[i] (mm; BMI in kg/m2), first 8 components shown
